# Widget Design Contract

Authoritative token and layout contract for the widget page. `tests/test_page.py` reads this file by
path and asserts the exact token names below, so this file cannot move into `docs/`.

## Color Tokens

- `--widget-bg: #101014`
- `--widget-fg: #f4f4f5`

## Layout Tokens

- `--widget-gutter: 16px`
